elementAgentBridge.claudeExecutable.description: Absolute path or command name for the Claude Code CLI. Empty uses PATH and known Windows install locations.

elementAgentBridge.codexExecutable.description: Absolute path or command name for the Codex CLI. Empty uses PATH and known Windows install locations.

elementAgentBridge.browserExecutable.description: Absolute path or command name for Edge or Chrome. Empty auto-detects an installed browser.

elementAgentBridge.autoSubmit.description: Press Enter after placing a prompt into a confirmed agent terminal. Disabled by default.

elementAgentBridge.terminalStartupDelayM.description: Delay before placing a prompt into a newly launched CLI terminal.

elementAgentBridge.keepContextFiles.description: Keep older captured context files. When disabled, only the latest capture is retained.

elementAgentBridge.contextPreviewLength.description: Maximum reference preview length shown in the chat response.
